name: SITELINE
tagline: Round-based tactical FPS at a desert relay station

teams.attack: Sappers: plant the charge on whichever site the match seed picked
teams.defend: Custodians: hold that site, defuse the charge, or run the clock out

controls.LMB: fire (automatic for rifle/SMG/LMG, single shot for DMR and shotgun)
controls.E: hold to plant on the active site
controls.F: hold to defuse with a kit
controls.1-5: buy weapon (buy phase) · 6 armour · 7-9 grenades · 0 defuse kit

systems.simulation: Fixed 120 Hz step (sim.js + movement.js + bots.js) separated from rendering (main.js). Rendering reads state, never mutates it.
systems.matchSeed: Each match draws a seed that selects one of two objective layouts: RELAY A inside the hall, or TRANSFORMER B in the west yard. Defender holds, attacker stages and the plant zone all follow the active site.
systems.combat: Hitscan traces against head/torso/leg boxes, 4x head and 0.75x legs, armour halves body damage. Spread grows with speed, recoil and airtime; each weapon has a fixed spray pattern so the first shots are tight and the tail climbs.
systems.weapons: VARL-7 rifle (27 dmg/600 rpm, $2700), Kestrel 9 SMG (18/900, $1250), Warden 62 DMR (62/200, $1700), Breacher 12 shotgun (8 pellets, $1400), Vulcan 60 LMG (24/750, 60-round belt, $4750).
systems.grenades: Frag ($300, radial damage), smoke ($200, 12 s cloud that blocks bot sight lines), flash ($250, blinds defenders with line of sight for 2.6 s). Stock is per type, two of each at most.
systems.economy: Start $800. Round win pays $3250 + $250 per round played; a losing side earns a streak bonus $1400-$3400. Kills pay $300 + $50 per round. Purchases only in the buy phase, so late rounds buy better guns.
systems.objective: Charge plants in 3.2 s on the active site, 40 s fuse, 5 s defuse. Rounds end by detonation, defuse, elimination or timeout; a round summary shows score, income and next-round reward.
systems.bots: Nav-graph A* with visibility-checked edges, throttled perception, reaction delay, noise investigation, cover-seeking reloads, stuck re-pathing, smoke that cuts sight and flash blindness.
systems.map: Relay station: west arcade with a sandstone colonnade, east freight lane with teal steel, splitter block, two-door hall, transformer yard, crates and cargo cover, painted site decals, signage per site.
systems.presentation: Dusk palette (sand, teal, ember), procedural canvas textures, gradient sky, stronger key light with cheap shadows, first-person viewmodel with muzzle flash and recoil, procedural WebAudio cues for shots, hits, steps, planting and round end.

files.game/main.js: renderer wiring, input, 120 Hz accumulator, debug hooks
files.game/sim.js: fixed-step phase clock, planting/defusing, grenade ticking, win conditions
files.game/combat.js: weapons, hit traces, damage, recoil patterns, grenade effects, smoke occlusion
files.game/bots.js: bot perception, A* routes, hold/investigate/cover states, smoke and flash response
files.game/map.js: two site layouts, collision solids, ray tests, defender anchors
files.game/world.js: three.js scene, lane materials, per-site signage, viewmodel
files.game/hud.js: DOM HUD, buy menu wiring, kill feed, round summary
files.game/state.js: single state object, constants, economy, round lifecycle
files.game/index.html: import map for three 0.187.0, HUD markup and styling

debugHooks.purpose: test scaffolding used by tests/browser.py and the screenshot capture; not gameplay cheats
debugHooks.__advance(seconds): step the fixed simulation without a browser frame
debugHooks.__tp(x,z,yaw,pitch): teleport the player for deterministic captures
debugHooks.__debug(): phase, timer, score, site, ammo, grenade stock, bomb, summary and per-bot state
debugHooks.__buy(id) __fire() __reload(): drive the same code paths the input layer calls
debugHooks.__pause(flag): freeze simulation time so a frame can be captured
debugHooks.?seed=N: pin the objective layout for tests and captures
debugHooks.?nobots=1: spawn no bots for the objective test and buy-menu capture
